例句

  1. An elderly woman sitting next to me on the train asked me where I was going.
    火車上坐在我旁邊的一位老太太問我要去哪裡。
  2. The boy playing the piano is my brother.
    在彈鋼琴的那個男孩是我弟弟。
  3. Do you know the man standing at the door?
    你認識站在門口的那個男人嗎？
  4. The girl talking with Tom is a new student.
    正在跟 Tom 說話的那個女孩是新同學。
  5. The children swimming in the river are my cousins.
    在河裡游泳的那些小孩是我的表兄弟姊妹。
  6. A man wearing a black hat came into the shop.
    一個戴黑帽子的男人走進店裡。
  7. The students waiting for the bus looked cold.
    在等公車的學生們看起來很冷。
  8. I took a picture of a cat sleeping on the wall.
    我拍了一隻在牆上睡覺的貓。
  9. She asked me what time it was.
    她問我現在幾點。
  10. The teacher asked us if we had any questions.
    老師問我們有沒有問題。
  11. He asked me where I lived.
    他問我住在哪裡。
  12. My mother asked me why I was late.
    我媽媽問我為什麼遲到。
  13. A tourist asked me how she could get to the station.
    一位觀光客問我她要怎麼去車站。
  14. I didn't know where she lived.
    我不知道她住在哪裡。
  15. I asked Ann whether she wanted to come with us.
    我問 Ann 她想不想跟我們一起來。
  16. Can I ask you where you bought that bag?
    我可以問你那個包包是在哪裡買的嗎？
  17. Please ask him when the meeting starts.
    請你問他會議什麼時候開始。
  18. My grandfather asked me which university I wanted to go to.
    我爺爺問我想上哪一所大學。
  19. Nobody knew what time the store closed.
    沒有人知道那家店幾點關門。
  20. I wondered why the bus was so late.
    我很納悶公車怎麼這麼晚。
  21. Tom asked me if I knew Ann's phone number.
    Tom 問我知不知道 Ann 的電話號碼。
  22. The old man sitting on the bench asked me what day it was.
    坐在長椅上的那位老先生問我今天星期幾。
  23. A woman carrying a big bag asked me where the exit was.
    一位提著大包包的女士問我出口在哪裡。
  24. I didn't know what Tom wanted for his birthday.
    我不知道 Tom 生日想要什麼。
  25. A little girl standing alone at the station asked me where the toilet was.
    一個獨自站在車站的小女孩問我廁所在哪裡。
  26. Who is the girl dancing with Tom?
    跟 Tom 跳舞的那個女孩是誰？
  27. She wondered if Tom was still angry.
    她不知道 Tom 是不是還在生氣。
  28. A man sitting next to me on the plane asked me where I was from.
    飛機上坐在我旁邊的一個男人問我從哪裡來。
  29. I asked the driver how much the ticket was.
    我問司機車票多少錢。
  30. I asked the waiter whether the curry was spicy.
    我問服務生咖哩辣不辣。
  31. The woman selling flowers asked me who the flowers were for.
    賣花的女士問我那些花是要送給誰的。
